description: Implementation of the Trickle timer as specified in RFC 6206, including functions for creating, starting, stopping, and managing the timer, with support for interval doubling and suppression logic.

methods.name: net_trickle_create
methods.description: Initializes a Trickle timer with specified minimum and maximum intervals and redundancy constant.

methods.name: net_trickle_start
methods.description: Starts the Trickle timer with a callback and user data.

methods.name: net_trickle_consistency
methods.description: Indicates a consistent reception, increasing the counter.

methods.name: net_trickle_inconsistency
methods.description: Indicates an inconsistency, resetting the interval to minimum.
